LanguageData.TM_MakeCastScroll_EtherShell.label: make ether shell cast scroll
LanguageData.TM_MakeCastScroll_EtherShell.description: Requires a mage who knows Ether Shell. Protects the caster or an allied pawn from vacuum and extreme cold for one day. Grants full vacuum resistance, prevents vacuum burns and lowers minimum comfortable temperature by 300 C. Does not protect from bullets, fire or heat, and does not heal injuries. Cannot stack or refresh while active. Use from inventory. Consumes one scroll after a successful cast. Anyone can use it without mana or learned magic. Fixed one-day duration. Range: 12 cells. Preparation: 1 second. Cooldown: 60 seconds.
LanguageData.TM_MakeSpellStaff_EtherShell.label: make charged ether shell staff
LanguageData.TM_MakeSpellStaff_EtherShell.description: Requires a mage who knows Ether Shell. Protects the caster or an allied pawn from vacuum and extreme cold for one day. Fixed one-day duration. Range: 12 cells. Preparation: 1 second. Cooldown: 60 seconds.
